whenToUse: Comparing values across categories: revenue by channel, deals by owner, headcount by department.
Ranked lists with Bar list when a full chart is too heavy.
Grouped or stacked comparisons and negative values with a zero line.
avoidWhen: Trends over continuous time — use Line or Area chart.
Parts of a whole with few slices — consider Donut chart.
a11y: Value labels or the generated summary make exact values available without hover.
Keep category labels short and readable; horizontal bars for long labels.
